Search 'wheelchair' navigates to /products?search=wheelchair and filters to 2 results. New Patient Medicare form submits successfully → new-patient-success shown; lead persisted. ui_bugs.issue: Task expects data-testid=catnav-all for the 'Shop All Departments' link. Actual testid rendered is catnav-products because Layout.jsx line 125 derives testid from `n.to.split('/').pop() || 'all'` and pop() of '/products' returns 'products'. The label/functionality is fine; only the testid is off. Fix: hardcode catnav-all or add explicit `testid` key on the shop_all catNav entry.

action_items: Fix Layout.jsx catNav testid so the Shop All link exposes data-testid=catnav-all (currently catnav-products). One-line fix: add `testid: 'all'` on the shop_all entry and use it in the template.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:186 POST /api/leads uses model_config=extra='allow' + model_dump() — new fields (plan_type, items, total, promo_code, equipment_category) pass through unvalidated, which is currently intended but means backend does not enforce type/lead-type-specific required fields. Consider a discriminated union if strictness is needed later.

server.py:79-81 ADMIN_EMAILS allowlist branch is correct: empty env → skip check; non-empty → 403 when email not in list. Case-insensitive compare is good. Note: existing users in DB are not revoked if their email is later removed from allowlist — only /auth/session (login) enforces it, not /auth/me. If revocation is desired, extend get_current_user to re-check email against allowlist.
Layout.jsx catNav testid derivation is fragile (see UI bug). Prefer explicit per-item testid.
CartContext.jsx has no upper-bound qty limit (button lets you keep clicking +). Minor: consider max 99 to avoid absurd order totals.

Cart.jsx applyPromo lowercases via toUpperCase() but promo input has CSS `uppercase` (display only); underlying value still original. Comparison is fine (uppercased) but if user pastes 'care10 ' with trailing space, trim() handles it — OK.
NewPatient.jsx / Cart.jsx catch blocks swallow the axios error object. Consider `catch (err) { console.error(err); ... }` to help debugging in production.

rca of the issue: catnav-all missing: In /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx line 125, the JSX uses `data-testid={`catnav-${n.to.split('/').pop() || 'all'}`}`. For the first catNav entry {to:'/products', key:'shop_all'}, '/products'.split('/').pop() returns 'products' (truthy), so the fallback 'all' is never used. Result: element rendered as data-testid='catnav-products' instead of the expected 'catnav-all'. All other catnav testids are correct because their slugs (diabetes-care/mobility-aids/orthotics) happen to match the pop() of their paths. Fix: change catNav[0] to include an explicit `testid:'all'` and reference it, e.g., `data-testid={`catnav-${n.testid || n.to.split('/').pop()}`}`.
